name: Configures animation loop tags in TagManagerModal and imports a spritesheet via the interactive auto-slicer
description: Verify opening the dedicated TagManagerModal from the timeline ribbon, adding a new animation loop tag named Walk Cycle, and verifying the tagged clip displays on the timeline.

planSteps.description: Verify the studio workspace and bottom animation timeline are rendered
Click the 'Manage Tags' button in the bottom timeline
Verify the Animation Tags & Clips modal opens
Type 'Walk Cycle' into the tag name input field
Verify the new tag 'Walk Cycle' appears in the tag list
Click the 'Done' button to close the modal
Verify the modal is dismissed and the timeline is visible
